name: bluechip Chain and bundler
description: [bluechip] RPC and bundler calls, user operation latency and outcomes, gas, and market data freshness.

charts.name: RPC latency p50 / p95 by operation (ms)

query.mpl:
`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.chain.rpc.duration`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| bucket by `operation` to $__interval using interpolate_delta_histogram(0.5, 0.95)

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.chain.rpc.errors`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `kind` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.bundler.calls`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `rpc.method` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.bundler.calls`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| where `outcome` != "ok"
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `error_code` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.bundler.duration`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| bucket by `rpc.method` to $__interval using interpolate_delta_histogram(0.95)

charts.name: User operation send to receipt p50 / p95 (s)

query.mpl:
`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.user_ops.latency`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| bucket by `kind` to $__interval using interpolate_delta_histogram(0.5, 0.95)

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.user_ops.outcome`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.gas.price`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using avg
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.market.price_age`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using max
| group by `source` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.market.feed_gap`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using max
| group by `symbol` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.market.stream_reconnects`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `stream` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.paper.feed_pushes`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.paper.feed_age`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using max
| group using sum
